_comment: Origins IN-APP-BRIDGE.md is allowed to hand the Android app, on top of the
ones derived from lib/tiers.ts (FREE_BASE_URL / PRO_BASE_URL). Everything
here is a host we control and intend to serve the pages from. Adding an
entry is a deliberate act: it grants window.IncognitoBrowserApp — and with
it openUpgrade() and saveImage() — to every page on that origin, inside a
privacy browser's WebView, until the app team ships a release that changes
it. Nothing that is being released, parked, or served by a third party

extraOrigins.reason: The hostname the sites are moving to. IN-APP-BRIDGE.md:11 keeps it in the app's allowlist for the cutover so the swap does not need a second app release. Registered to us and not serving the pages yet.
